rule.roll: the roll itself; after the dot — its parts, as in the «Roll» step
rule.rolled: what came up on the dice of this roll
rule.number: the rolled field's number as is — for example, «Result: Athletics»
rule.threshold: what the result is compared with: the field number adjusted by the «Roll» step
rule.success: yes or no — the result of this roll's «Success if» row
rule.margin: a number — the result of this roll's «Margin as a number» row
rule.meaning: {{meaning}}; the name exists in every roll, no need to declare it

arrived.hint: — present in every roll; hover or click the name in a formula to see what it is

flow.label: What it returns
flow.title: what the roller gets: the whole roll, and after a dot — its parts, for example «roll.passed»
flow.underSaid: result no more than the threshold
flow.overSaid: result no less than the threshold{{gate}}

rule.label: Edited by
rule.title: Hanging effects whose roll edits touch the rolls of this rule: by its tag or without tags (all rolls)

palette.title: A ready pair of edits: it will arrive in the «Roll edits» section with all its words

word.empty: what does it do to the roll?
word.namePlaceholder: what it is called in your world
word.usedTitle: the roll edit is used by an effect

cancels.label: Cancels
cancels.onceAll: claim — for all rolls of the action
cancels.onceTip: Claimed at the table for an action: for all rolls of the claimant that the word fits, or only the first of them. Effect and item edits are not affected.
cancels.stackTip: One per roll — however many effects give the word. Once per each different effect — copies of the same effect count as one: two «Sustains» give the word once. «For each copy» — a number in the effect itself.

section.title: Roll edits
section.sub: Rule words: what «with advantage», «with disadvantage» mean. An effect or a claim at the table turns them on. A single effect's addend («+ d4») is written in the effect itself.
section.empty: No roll edits — rolls go as they are. Create your own word: «Advantage», «Head start», «Haste» — as it is called in your world. Or take a ready pair on the right.

row.serviceGroup: service fields that are not on the sheet
row.serviceMore: service fields that are not on the sheet ({{n}})…
row.pairHint: A die of two kinds; the sides of each are its own field
row.emptyHint: empty — success is counted by the «Check» in the effect

section.title: Rolls
section.sub: How the sheet's fields are rolled: a click on a field and a «Roll» step with a field.
section.emptyWithDie: They are optional: success can be counted by a «Check» step in the effect. To give a sheet field a «roll» button — create a die above and press «+ roll».
section.emptyNoDie: They are optional: success can be counted by a «Check» step in the effect. To give a sheet field a «roll» button — first create a die in «Dice» above.

dice.title: Dice
dice.sub: What checks are rolled with in this world. Usually there is one entry here; item dice live in the records themselves.
dice.addTitle: Which die: the preset will be placed in the list, then you can edit it
dice.empty: No dice. Create the one this world rolls checks with.
dice.reads: From what came up we take
dice.lockedHead: Cannot remove — the die is in use. First change it here:
dice.addPartTitle: A roll of named halves: Hope and Fear in Daggerheart

character.title: Sheets
character.deskTitle: What the table is given: rules that fire once for the whole room — for example, once per round
character.grantsSub: Applies to any sheet, whatever its type, and to a sheet without a type
character.emptySheet: The sheet is empty so far
character.dropPart: remove the table from the block — the table itself stays in «Tables»
character.dragTitle: drag up or down — this is how the block is placed on the sheet
character.addFieldTitle: one value: hit points, level, name

combat.title: Combat
combat.sub: How the table builds the turn order. Empty — the game master arranges the order by hand.
combat.bonusHint: A formula over the roller's sheet: dexterity.
combat.gridHint: Cells the tokens stand on; the distance to a target is counted from them.
combat.limitsHint: Limits cut off endless chains of answers. Usually they are left alone.

limit.handlerDepth: how many times one trigger in a chain

health.title: Health
health.sub: Which sheet fields are health and its limit. The table uses them to show a bar, a share and a step: «whole», «hurt», «unconscious».
health.stepsHint: A table: a row is a step. Read top to bottom: first the states, then the shares from larger to smaller.

toggles.title: Quick settings
toggles.sub: Switches that write data for you. What exactly got written is visible on the «Effects» tab.
toggles.needDamage: Armor needs a common damage effect — create it on the «Effects» tab in the «Common» group, and a switch will appear here.
toggles.noInput: The effect «{{name}}» has no sheet input — it is unclear whose hit points and armor to touch. Add a «sheet» input to it on the «Effects» tab.
toggles.replaced_one: The effect «{{name}}» will be rewritten: {{count}} step will be replaced with ready-made ones.
toggles.replaced_other: The effect «{{name}}» will be rewritten: {{count}} steps will be replaced with ready-made ones.
toggles.put: Ready-made steps will go into the effect «{{name}}».
